purpose: Apply targeted, auditable corrections after Codex methods audit and the accepted 2026-05-20 cdeep+Codex panel taxonomy-freeze decisions. Raw API outputs remain preserved separately.
global_rules: Retraction Watch Reason terms remain non-exclusive curated metadata signals, not fault, liability, cause, or responsibility determinations.
The four R/A/E/P domains are analyst-defined metadata signal domains for descriptive stratification.
Investigation-by-X labels identify investigation source/locus, not actor fault, oversight failure, or substantive cause.
Generic Misconduct-by-X and Miscommunication labels remain principal P-only in the main analysis for continuity but require contextual-exclusion sensitivity reporting.
Notice/status labels can retain semantic P mapping but remain contextual/not principal; No assigned primary domain means no principal R/A/E/P assignment, not absence of Retraction Watch metadata.
Object type governs plagiarism/duplication rules: text-only attribution, data/image evidence reliability, article-level R+A when appropriate.

Investigation by Journal/Publisher.caution: Investigation source/locus signal only; not actor fault, oversight failure, or substantive cause. Included as post-publication process-source metadata.

Investigation by Company/Institution.caution: Investigation source/locus signal only; not actor fault, oversight failure, or substantive cause. Included as post-publication process-source metadata.

Investigation by ORI.caution: Investigation source/locus signal only; not actor fault, oversight failure, or substantive cause. Included as post-publication process-source metadata.

Investigation by Third Party.caution: Investigation source/locus signal only; not actor fault, oversight failure, or substantive cause. Included as post-publication process-source metadata.

Miscommunication with/by Author.caution: Communication-process signal only; not misconduct, fault, or substantive retraction mechanism. Contextual-exclusion sensitivity is required.

Miscommunication with/by Company/Institu.caution: Communication-process signal only; not misconduct, fault, or substantive retraction mechanism. Contextual-exclusion sensitivity is required.

Miscommunication with/by Journal/Publish.caution: Communication-process signal only; not misconduct, fault, or substantive retraction mechanism. Contextual-exclusion sensitivity is required.

Miscommunication with/by Third Party.caution: Communication-process signal only; not misconduct, fault, or substantive retraction mechanism. Contextual-exclusion sensitivity is required.

Concerns/Issues about Third Party Involv.caution: Third-party involvement is too broad for a main mechanism category; retained only as a broad process/oversight audit signal.

Error by Third Party.caution: Third-party error is non-specific; retained only as a broad process/oversight audit signal.

Misconduct by Author.caution: Broad misconduct-process metadata; do not infer content, attribution, editorial mechanism, or actor responsibility unless a mechanism-specific co-label is present. Contextual-exclusion sensitivity is required.

Misconduct by Company/Institution.caution: Broad misconduct-process metadata; do not infer content, attribution, editorial mechanism, or actor responsibility unless a mechanism-specific co-label is present. Contextual-exclusion sensitivity is required.

Misconduct by Third Party.caution: Broad misconduct-process metadata; do not infer content, attribution, editorial mechanism, or actor responsibility unless a mechanism-specific co-label is present. Contextual-exclusion sensitivity is required.

Misconduct - Official Investigation(s) a.caution: Official investigation/finding signal; mechanism-specific R/A/E domains require separate data, image, authorship, or peer-review labels.

Ethical Violations by Author.caution: Generic ethical-violation label used when no more specific reason is available; do not infer content, attribution, or editorial mechanism from this label alone.

Computer-Aided Content or Computer-Gener.caution: Content-authenticity/reliability signal only for the principal analysis; do not infer authorship or disclosure failure without an explicit co-label.

Salami Slicing.caution: Content partitioning and publication-integrity signal; editorial/peer-review process assignment requires a separate editorial or peer-review reason label.

Duplication of Text.caution: Text-only duplication is treated as attribution/publication-integrity metadata, not research-content reliability; data, image, and article-level duplication follow separate object rules.
